The device fingerprint (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) was previously associated with a confirmed fraud case [EV-d5db4c58]. The customer confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and retained physical possession of the card [EV-080f73ce]. Prior fraud history includes one confirmed case (CC-4316) for this customer/card [EV-024394f3] and six similar card-not-present fraud cases in the database [EV-81cbba28]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict, consistent with the card-not-present fraud pattern and a fraud probability of 0.81. The total exposure of $1,413.01 across transactions 4012158, 4012159, and 4012160 represents the suspected fraudulent loss. This activity exhibits hallmarks of card-not-present fraud using a compromised device profile, and the customer's dispute supports unauthorized use. The case is referred for SAR filing under the card-not-present fraud typology.
